subject: Need to shift Friday's Northbridge demo — SE travel conflict
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@northbridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Apr 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Northbridge — walkthrough Friday 4/15 (30m) — draft agenda attached

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for taking time to connect. Quick note to lock the walkthrough for Friday, April 15th at 10:00am PT (30 minutes):

- Goal: show the baseline latency/cost dashboard and an early mapping of your ingest topology to our routing policies
- Attendees: Sarah (Product), Tom (Ops), our SE (Karthik) + me

I attached a short agenda and a mutual-action-plan stub so we can keep this focused. If that slot works, I will send the calendar invite. If you need a slightly earlier or later option, I can do 9:30am or 11:00am PT.

Also, quick FYI — Karthik is currently booked for a short onsite the day prior and is flying back overnight; he said he should be available but asked me to confirm if we can shift by 30–45 minutes if anything comes up on his travel.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0132

Attachments: Agenda_v1.docx, MAP_v2.pdf

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@northbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hayes <tom.h@northbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Northbridge — walkthrough Friday 4/15 (30m) — draft agenda attached

Hi Marissa —

10:00am PT on Friday works for us. One ask — our VP of Eng (Ellen Park) is joining the office that morning and may need to step into another meeting around 10:20. If possible, could we either start at 9:45 and keep it tight to 25 minutes, or shift to 11:00 so Ellen can attend the full time?

Also, can you confirm who will run the demo if Karthik is delayed?

Thanks,
Sarah
Product Lead, Northbridge Capital

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Apr 2028 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: internal: NB demo — coverage & timing (possible flight delay)

Folks —

Heads up: Sarah confirmed 10:00am PT but their VP may only be available earlier (9:45) or at 11:00. My preference is keep it at 11:00 so Ellen can attend, but Karthik flagged he has a redeye returning on Thursday night and there is a chance he won't be fully online until 10:30 local. Options:

1) Move to 11:00 PT and Karthik leads as planned
2) Keep 10:00 and have Connor step in as SE cover (Connor, can you run a short 25m baseline? I can handle the intros and followups)
3) Start at 9:45 and keep it tight — risky if Karthik is delayed and Ellen wants longer

Connor — can you confirm availability for option 2 (10:00) and whether you can demo the latency dashboard + routing policy mapping in ~25 minutes? If yes I will propose 10:00 with you as primary and Karthik on standby.

If neither works I will propose 11:00 to the customer.

—Marissa

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Apr 2028 12:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: internal: NB demo — coverage & timing (possible flight delay)

On Fri, Apr 12, 2028 at 12:10 PM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Connor — can you confirm availability for option 2 (10:00) and whether you can demo the latency dashboard + routing policy mapping in ~25 minutes?

Yep — I can cover 10:00 PT and keep it tight to 25 minutes. Will run the same lightweight flow I use for early discovery: quick metrics page, two config examples, then a short Q&A. I’ll use the MAP_v2.pdf as the follow-up doc.

Karthik — if travel lands you after 10:00, no pressure — you can join for Q&A or I’ll capture the session recording and loop you in.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@northbridge.com>
Cc: Tom Hayes <tom.h@northbridge.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 13 Apr 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Northbridge — walkthrough Friday 4/15 (30m) — draft agenda attached

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the heads-up. To make sure Ellen can attend we will keep Friday at 10:00am PT but tighten to 25 minutes and Connor will run the demo as primary. Karthik will join as soon as he’s back on the ground (likely by 10:30) and will be available for the Q&A portion. If Ellen prefers the full 30 minutes we can move to 11:00 — happy to do that too if you prefer.

Here are the confirmed options so you can pick quickly:
- Option A (confirmed): Friday 4/15, 10:00–10:25am PT — Connor demo, recording provided, Karthik joins for Q&A
- Option B: Friday 4/15, 11:00–11:30am PT — Karthik leads end-to-end (best if Ellen wants the deeper walkthrough)

Please reply with A or B and I’ll send a calendar invite + MAP_v2.pdf (short follow-up with next steps & owners).

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachments to be sent after confirmation: MAP_v2.pdf (mutual action plan), Recording_stub.mp4 (post-demo recording)
